lastResponse.text: Yes, I hear you. First, quick safety check: are you feeling sick right now without your insulin, like confusion, vomiting, or trouble breathing? If yes, call nine one one now. If you can talk, one next step is to call Motel Shelter at 5-0-3, 2-5-5, 4-4-4-4. They have a motel-shelter waitlist and can screen eligibility. If you want, I can repeat that number slowly again.
originalTexts: Yes, I hear you. First, quick safety check: are you feeling sick right now without your insulin, like confusion, vomiting, or trouble breathing? If yes, call **9-1-1** now. If you can talk, one next step is to call **Motel Shelter** at **5-0-3, 2-5-5, 4-4-4-4**. They have a motel-shelter waitlist and can screen eligibility. If you want, I can repeat that number slowly again.
